eyebrow.zh: 本地 · 可验的提速 · 一行接入

headline.zh:
工具调用不再打断解码
本地 tps 重新跑满
headline.en:
Tool calls stop breaking the decode
Local tps runs full again

sub.zh: 多 token 解码模型一步能吐多个 token，可 agent 每次工具调用都在窗口中途打断流，把多 token 吞吐压回单 token。MTP-Align 把工具调用对齐到解码窗口边界，让每个窗口跑满。
sub.en: A multi-token decode model emits several tokens per step — yet every agent tool call cuts the stream mid-window and collapses that throughput back to one token at a time. MTP-Align lines tool calls up to the decode-window boundary so every window runs to completion.

title.zh: 找回来的，是每次工具调用丢掉的吞吐
title.en: It recovers the throughput every tool call throws away

body.zh: 你的模型一步能解出多个 token，可 agent 一触发工具调用就打断解码流，把多 token 批次剩下的 token 全浪费、吞吐压回单 token。这部分损失没有别的工具在量——MTP-Align 把工具调用对齐到解码窗口边界，让没被用上的解码能力变回实在的本地提速。
body.en: Your model can decode several tokens per step, but the moment the agent fires a tool call it cuts the decode stream and wastes the rest of that multi-token batch — throughput drops back to one token at a time. No other tool measures that loss. MTP-Align aligns tool calls to the decode-window boundary and turns unused decode capacity into real local speedup.

chips: › 多 token 批次不再半途作废

title.zh: 一行环境变量，agent 不改代码
title.en: One env var — no agent code change

body.zh: 在你跑着的 agent 和模型服务之间插一个进程：agent 只改一个 base URL 指过来，工具调用就自动对齐到解码窗口边界。不用 fork agent、不用改它的循环、不引入云依赖。
body.en: Drop one process between your running agent and model server: point the agent's base URL at it and tool calls auto-align to the decode-window boundary. No forking the agent, no rewriting its loop, no cloud dependency.

chips: › 兼容现有 agent 接口

title.en: Speedup by the numbers, not vibes

body.zh: 一条命令打印工具调用打断 vs 对齐两种模式的前后 tps 表——吞吐差多少、解码连续性多少，白纸黑字。合成模型上界 +9.2%，真正的 kill-gate 是打你跑着的模型服务：差不到 5%，项目就到此为止。
body.en: One command prints a before/after tps table — interrupted vs. aligned — so the throughput delta and decode continuity are in black and white. The synthetic upper bound is +9.2%; the real kill-gate hits your live model server: under 5% and the project stops.

chips: › 真 kill-gate 打你的模型服务

title.zh: 本地 · 开源 · 无云

body.zh: 代理和基准都 MIT 开源、免费。解码本来就在你本机——所以没有云、没有账号、没有外发。舰队遥测和 SLA 是以后的事，单机提速这一核心，永不设墙。
body.en: The proxy and benchmark are MIT open source and free. Decode already runs on your machine — so no cloud, no account, no egress. Fleet telemetry and SLA are for later; the core act of single-node speedup is never gated.

headline.zh: 让没被用上的解码能力，变回本地提速
headline.en: Turn unused decode capacity back into local speedup

sub.zh: 开源、MIT、无付费墙。本地提速这一核心，永不设墙。
sub.en: Open source, MIT, no paywall. The core act of local speedup is never gated.

tag.zh: 给本地多 token 解码模型的 agent 工具调用批对齐代理
tag.en: The agent tool-call batching proxy for local multi-token decode models
